issues.title: Ingest Polk County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $15,035,575 across 28 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($7,435,415), Road Fund ($3,065,315), Road Improvement Sales Tax Fund ($2,605,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
